theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → ∀ (h : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (G : Eucl P → Eucl P), LipschitzWith L h → Measurable G → (∀ x, ‖G x‖ ≤ L) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Q → G x ∈ Q ∧ ∀ u ∈ Q, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => h (x + s • u)) (inner ℝ (G x) u) 0) → ∀ Y : Eucl P → Eucl P, Integrable Y ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Q → Y x ∈ Q) → ∀ g : ℕ → Eucl P → ℝ, (∀ k, Differentiable ℝ (g k)) → (∀ k, LipschitzWith L (g k)) → TendstoUniformly g h atTop → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in M, fderiv ℝ (g k) x (Y x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in M, inner ℝ (G x) (Y x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))))
